channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: National Napping Day… but Monday Club Night won’t wait!
item.description: National Napping Day or not, Monday Club Night is on at Claremont: Grade 2 Ladies Navan ‘B’ vs Navan ‘A’, two courts available from 8:30pm, and Juveniles at 6:30pm (Girls) and 7:30pm (Boys).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium: Match Night, Two Courts & Juvenile Club
item.description: Monday Club Night is back in Claremont Stadium with Grade 7 Mens (Navan ‘B’ vs Drumree), two adult courts from 8:30pm, and Juvenile Club sessions for girls (6:30pm) and boys (7:30pm).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Thursday Club Night + Grade 3 Ladies: Navan 'B' vs Ardee
item.description: Thursday Club Night: two courts from 9pm, an extra 30 minutes of play, and a Grade 3 Ladies clash as Navan 'B' take on Ardee.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: No Club Night Tonight: Three Matches, One Packed Schedule
item.description: No club night for members tonight as the courts are fully booked with three matches: Grade 3 Mens (Navan vs Ardee B) and two Grade 5 Mens ties (Navan vs Bailieboro, Navan B vs Ardee B).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium ☕
item.description: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium featuring Grade 4 Mixed: Navan 'B' vs Mullingar 'A', plus juvenile sessions and extra courts for members from 8:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Club Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us tonight at Claremont Stadium for an exciting badminton match and open courts for all members. Let's make it a night to remember!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
